claims.paper_location: Methods, 'The regime-route molecular encoder'; Eq. (1); Algorithm 1 step 1
claims.statement: The molecular branch emits a three-route transport-susceptibility vector normalised apart from its magnitude, with a plaque-blind direct effect
The imaging branch emits positive route resistances plus a composition index that varies with necrotic core, cap thickness and bleeding

claims.paper_location: Methods, 'Reaction-norm coupling and the decline-to-condition gate'; Eq. (1)-(2)
claims.statement: The pair score is the reaction norm of the two vectors under an interaction-variance gate that declines to condition when the plaque axis carries no signal
The rank objective weights each plaque's pairs by its stratum agreement coefficient
The composite objective is the weighted sum of the rank, property, sparsity and consistency terms
The certified top-k set is returned only when the margin clears twice the Lipschitz radius, otherwise the affected entries are deferred
Training is two-stage: auxiliary molecular supervision first, then joint fitting over minibatches

claims.paper_location: Methods, 'Cohort construction and auxiliary data'; Table 3
claims.statement: Splits are patient-level and site-stratified, one site and region is a held-out external fold, and normalisation statistics come from the training partition only

claims.paper_location: Results, Section 2.1 (twelve planned tests under Holm-Bonferroni); Methods, 'Evaluation protocol'
claims.statement: The confirmatory family is Holm-adjusted over the pre-specified comparisons and the exploratory set is controlled at a false discovery rate
Rank agreement and NDCG at the declared depth are reported per stratum on a shared held-out fold
Component necessity is reported per tier with the interaction ratio of each joint removal against its single removals
Transport is reported per out-of-distribution condition with the paired within-record difference alongside the marginal column difference
Clinical increment, net benefit at a 20% threshold, calibration slope and the share crossing the published reference level are reported per arm, site and comparator
The molecular branch is compared on the assay endpoint as well as the penetration endpoint, and the direction of the reversal is reported
Reader agreement is compared between the unassisted and the assisted reading of the same records

claims.paper_location: Methods, 'Cohort construction' (independent label pipeline, prohibited site features)
claims.statement: The composition index is image-only, the label pipeline is independent of the feature pipeline, and site-proxy features are excluded
The public molecular resources carry their versions, licences and access links

deviations.departure: optimiser, learning rate, weight decay, schedule, warmup fraction, epoch count, batch size, gradient clipping, EMA decay and precision
deviations.reason: the manuscript prints none of these; they are engineering defaults exposed in configs/train and reachable from the command line

deviations.departure: contrast channel count, volume grid, stem width and stage schedule
deviations.reason: the manuscript names multi-contrast three-dimensional imaging and a T1-weighted channel without printing a protocol; the channel order is fixed so a missing channel is a zero block rather than a shifted tensor

deviations.departure: atom and bond feature blocks, element valence rules, hydrogen-count estimate and hybridisation assignment
deviations.reason: the manuscript fixes the branch's role, not its featurisation; the organic-subset conventions are documented in the module

deviations.departure: the coupling capacity d_cap, the rank cap, the softplus alternative for the positive resistance link, the four loss weights and the rank temperature
deviations.reason: the manuscript states the low-rank bilinear form, the three routes and that the weights are fixed on the training folds, without printing the values

deviations.departure: the admissible perturbation radius and the encoder Lipschitz constant
deviations.reason: the manuscript defines the radius as a bound on admissible input variation without printing it; both are configuration entries and both are reported by cli.certify

deviations.departure: the per-record noise term is scaled by the ratio of the reference plaque volume to the recorded volume
deviations.reason: the manuscript states that the resistance vector is measured from a noisier or smaller area and that the plaque encoder's front end carries it; the scaling is the release's implementation of that statement

deviations.departure: the release ships a schema-compatible cohort fixture instead of the cohort
deviations.location: Methods, 'Cohort construction and auxiliary data', Layer (i)
deviations.reason: the multi-centre cohort is private and obtainable only from the corresponding author under a data-use statement; every cohort-level value in Tables 1-4 is therefore NOT_RUN and no cohort value is reproduced from the fixture

deviations.departure: the public assay releases are read from caller-supplied tables rather than downloaded
deviations.reason: the release performs no network access; dataset_urls.txt records the verified access links and the licence of each resource

deviations.departure: removing the molecular branch leaves a candidate-independent score, so the fixture-scale candidate ordering is degenerate and is reported as NOT_RUN rather than as a rank agreement
deviations.reason: a plaque-only score cannot order candidates within a plaque; the manuscript's value for that row is a single-modality comparator and is not a candidate-level rank agreement

deviations.departure: the reader arm is exercised on fixture readings rather than on recorded reader sessions
deviations.reason: no reader session data accompanies the manuscript; the reader statistics are computed by the release's own estimators and are labelled fixture-scale in every report

scope: manuscript claim to code mapping with the deviation register
